app.name: pinthis — publish to your name
app.description: Publish a page, a folder, or a zip to IPFS and point one of your names at it. Your name serves the content from the gateway and natively over ipfs://.

capabilities.reason: Claim a free <you>.pinthis name to publish under.
Show the names you can publish to.
Pin your files and point the chosen name at the result. The publish pipeline itself writes the pointer records declared below; this app never composes DNS records by hand.
Show whether a name currently has a published site.

site_pointer.meaning: Points the name at the published site's content hash; the gateway and ipfs:// both serve it.
site_pointer.x-platform-reserved-tag: The `ipfs` tag is platform-reserved (HANDSHAKE-APPS.md section 6); this manifest may declare it because content.publish routes every write through the publish pipeline that owns the pointer (publishing.services._point_zone_at), and dns_records.publish_pointer treats exactly this shape as the site pointer.

archive_pointer.meaning: Permanent Arweave copy of a single-file publish; served when no IPFS pointer exists.

gateway_a.meaning: Makes the name reachable in ordinary browsers by pointing it at the HNS.ONE gateway, which serves the pinned content.

ui.x-note: A first-party browser page. A third-party re-implementation would live at an origin under its own name, such as app.pinthis.hns.one.
